raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`MiMoDetector` (`--tool-call-parser mimo`) drops tool calls in three cases:

1. **A parameter schema uses a `type` list, e.g. `{"type": ["string", "null"]}`.** `_get_param_type` returns the list, and `_convert_param_value` calls `.startswith` on it, which raises `AttributeError`. In the non-streaming path, `serving_chat` catches the exception and returns the whole `<tool_call>` block as plain content, so the call is lost. OpenAI strict-mode schemas and many MCP tools use this form. `anyOf` schemas (`Optional[int]`) don't crash, but they fall back to `"string"`, so `5` comes back as `"5"`.
2. **The model emits a number that overflows, e.g. `1e400`.** `int(float("1e400"))` raises `OverflowError`, which is not in the `except` tuple. The call is lost the same way.
3. **One streaming chunk contains more than one complete `<tool_call>` block** (MTP, `--stream-interval > 1`, parallel tool calls). `parse_streaming_increment` handles only the first block. The rest stays in the buffer and is lost if no further chunk arrives. MiMo doesn't override `finish()`, so nothing flushes it at stream end.

Repro (CPU only):

```python
from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Function, Tool
from sglang.srt.function_call.mimo_detector import MiMoDetector

tools = [Tool(type="function", function=Function(name="search", parameters={
    "type": "object", "properties": {"site": {"type": ["string", "null"]}}}))]
text = "<tool_call>\n<function=search>\n<parameter=site>github.com</parameter>\n</function>\n</tool_call>"
MiMoDetector().detect_and_parse(text, tools)
# AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'startswith'
```

## Modifications

- `_get_param_type` now resolves the type through the shared `infer_type_from_json_schema` helper (the same approach `Qwen3CoderDetector` uses). It handles `type` lists, `anyOf`/`oneOf`, `enum`, etc.
- The number branch of `_convert_param_value` also catches `OverflowError` and falls back to the raw string, the same fallback it uses for other conversion failures.
- `parse_streaming_increment` loops until no complete block is left in the buffer. Per-block bookkeeping moves into `_parse_complete_block`. Single-block behavior is unchanged.
- New `test/registered/unit/function_call/test_mimo_detector.py`, registered in `base-a-test-cpu`, with one regression case per bug. All four fail on `main` and pass with this change. They are in a new file because `test_function_call_parser.py` is already about 6k lines.

Out of scope, to discuss separately: a string parameter whose value is literally `null` becomes `None`, an invalid boolean silently becomes `false` (the same pattern as #42764 for qwen3_coder), and text after the last tool call is never released in streaming.

## Accuracy Tests

Parser-only change, no effect on model forward.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not needed.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Unit tests for MiMoDetector - no server, no model loading."""
+
+import json
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Function, Tool
+from sglang.srt.function_call.mimo_detector import MiMoDetector
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _make_tools():
+    return [
+        Tool(
+            type="function",
+            function=Function(
+                name="search",
+                parameters={
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "query": {"type": "string"},
+                        "site": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                        "limit": {"anyOf": [{"type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}]},
+                        "threshold": {"type": "number"},
+                    },
+                },
+            ),
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+def _call(**params):
+    body = "".join(f"<parameter={k}>{v}</parameter>" for k, v in params.items())
+    return f"<tool_call>\n<function=search>\n{body}\n</function>\n</tool_call>"
+
+
+class TestMiMoDetectorParamTypes(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.tools = _make_tools()
+
+    def _parse_args(self, text):
+        result = MiMoDetector().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+        self.assertEqual(len(result.calls), 1)
+        return json.loads(result.calls[0].parameters)
+
+    def test_type_array_schema_parses(self):
+        """A `"type": [..., "null"]` property must not abort parsing of the whole call."""
+        args = self._parse_args(_call(query="sglang", site="github.com"))
+        self.assertEqual(args, {"query": "sglang", "site": "github.com"})
+
+    def test_any_of_schema_converts_to_inner_type(self):
+        """An Optional[int] (`anyOf` with null) property is converted to an int, not left a string."""
+        args = self._parse_args(_call(query="sglang", limit="5"))
+        self.assertEqual(args["limit"], 5)
+
+    def test_out_of_range_number_does_not_abort_parse(self):
+        """A number that overflows to inf must not abort parsing of the whole call."""
+        args = self._parse_args(_call(query="sglang", threshold="1e400"))
+        self.assertEqual(args["query"], "sglang")
+
+
+class TestMiMoDetectorStreaming(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_multiple_calls_in_one_chunk(self):
+        """Every complete call in a chunk is emitted, not only the first one."""
+        detector = MiMoDetector()
+        text = _call(query="a") + "\n" + _call(query="b")
+        result = detector.parse_streaming_increment(text, _make_tools())
+
+        self.assertEqual([c.tool_index for c in result.calls], [0, 1])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [json.loads(c.parameters)["query"] for c in result.calls], ["a", "b"]
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
